meta.cite: Barton O. Oliver's mTOR Atlas. doi:10.5281/zenodo.22059963

data.mechanism: Active mTORC1, acting through the transcription factor c-MYC, raises production of MAT2A, the enzyme that makes SAM, so a growing cell makes more of its main methyl donor.
data.mechanism_beginner: mTORC1 tells the cell to make more SAM.
data.boundary: Human cell lines and mouse xenograft tumours; acts through c-MYC on MAT2A. Together with SAM-SAMTOR this forms a loop whose behaviour in normal tissue is untested. Single study.
